# pve_backup_job (Data Source)

Reads a vzdump backup job definition (`GET /cluster/backup/{id}`) together with the per-job included volume tree (`GET /cluster/backup/{id}/included_volumes`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_backup_job" "daily" {
  id = "daily"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The job ID to read.

### Read-Only

- `all` (Boolean) Whether all known guest systems on the host are backed up.
- `bwlimit` (Number) I/O bandwidth limit in KiB/s.
- `comment` (String) Description for the job.
- `compress` (String) Dump file compression. One of `0`, `1`, `gzip`, `lzo`, `zstd`.
- `dumpdir` (String) Directory the resulting files are written to.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the job is enabled.
- `exclude` (List of String) Guest IDs excluded from the job (when `all` is set).
- `exclude_path` (List of String) Shell globs excluded from container backups.
- `fleecing` (Attributes) Backup fleecing options (VM only); null when not configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fleecing))
- `included_volumes` (Attributes List) Tree of guests (and their volumes) included in this job, with the inclusion decision and reason per volume. Guests that were removed but not purged appear with type `unknown`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--included_volumes))
- `ionice` (Number) IO priority when using the BFQ scheduler; between 0 and 8 (8 is idle priority).
- `lockwait` (Number) Maximal time to wait for the global lock in minutes.
- `mailnotification` (String) Deprecated by PVE: when a notification mail is sent. One of `always`, `failure`.
- `mailto` (String) Deprecated by PVE: comma-separated list of email addresses or users receiving notifications.
- `mode` (String) Backup mode. One of `snapshot`, `suspend`, `stop`.
- `next_run` (Number) UNIX timestamp when this backup job will be executed next.
- `node` (String) Node the job is pinned to, when set on the job.
- `notes_template` (String) Template string for generating notes for the backup(s).
- `notification_mode` (String) Which notification system to use. One of `auto`, `legacy-sendmail`, `notification-system`.
- `pbs_change_detection_mode` (String) PBS change detection mode for container backups. One of `legacy`, `data`, `metadata`.
- `performance` (Attributes) Performance-related settings; null when not configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--performance))
- `pigz` (Number) pigz thread count for gzip compression.
- `pool` (String) Pool whose guest systems are backed up.
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether backup(s) are marked as protected.
- `prune_backups` (Attributes) Retention options overriding the storage configuration; null when not configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prune_backups))
- `quiet` (Boolean) Whether log output is suppressed on the node.
- `remove` (Boolean) Whether older backups are pruned according to `prune_backups`.
- `repeat_missed` (Boolean) Whether a missed run is repeated as soon as possible.
- `schedule` (String) Backup schedule in PVE's systemd calendar-event subset.
- `script` (String) Hook script used by the job.
- `stdexcludes` (Boolean) Whether temporary files and logs are excluded.
- `stop` (Boolean) Whether running backup jobs on this host are stopped.
- `stopwait` (Number) Maximal time to wait until a guest system is stopped in minutes.
- `storage` (String) Storage the resulting file is written to.
- `tmpdir` (String) Directory for temporary files.
- `vmid` (List of String) Guest IDs backed up by the job.
- `zstd` (Number) Zstd thread count (`0` means half of the available cores).

<a id="nestedatt--fleecing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fleecing`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether backup fleecing is enabled.
- `storage` (String) Storage used for fleecing images.


<a id="nestedatt--included_volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `included_volumes`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the guest.
- `type` (String) Type of the guest. One of `qemu`, `lxc`, `unknown`.
- `vmid` (Number) VMID of the guest.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) Volumes of the guest with their inclusion information. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--included_volumes--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--included_volumes--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `included_volumes.volumes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Configuration key of the volume (e.g. `scsi0`).
- `included` (Boolean) Whether the volume is included in the backup.
- `name` (String) Name of the volume.
- `reason` (String) Reason why the volume is included (or excluded).



<a id="nestedatt--performance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `performance`

Read-Only:

- `max_workers` (Number) Maximum parallel IO workers for VMs.
- `pbs_entries_max` (Number) Entry limit held in memory for container backups sent to PBS.


<a id="nestedatt--prune_backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prune_backups`

Read-Only:

- `keep_all` (Boolean) Whether all backups are kept.
- `keep_daily` (Number) Backups kept for the last N different days.
- `keep_hourly` (Number) Backups kept for the last N different hours.
- `keep_last` (Number) Number of most recent backups kept.
- `keep_monthly` (Number) Backups kept for the last N different months.
- `keep_weekly` (Number) Backups kept for the last N different weeks.
- `keep_yearly` (Number) Backups kept for the last N different years.
